english.title: Fail to stop vehicle for traffic survey when directed by constable / traffic warden / traffic officer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person

(A)_[driving]_
(B)_[propelling]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), neglected or refused to stop the vehicle when directed to do so by a

(C)_[constable]_
(D)_[traffic warden]_
(E)_[traffic officer]_

being a direction given for the purposes of a traffic survey being carried out on or in the vicinity of a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(2)(b)(i) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H2501 and H2502.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) and failed to stop the vehicle as directed by a

(A)_[constable]_
(B)_[traffic warden]_
(E)_[traffic officer]_

for the purposes of a traffic survey.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
